cohort: The study involved 104 preterm infants with a gestational age of less than 34 weeks who were treated in a neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: Gestational age at birth was the most significant predictor of melatonin levels in preterm infants, with lower levels observed in extremely and very preterm infants compared to moderate preterm infants.
mod_finding: No significant correlation was found between melatonin concentration and mode of delivery.
cross-section timing: During treatment in the neonatal intensive care unit
